_comment: Example incident spec for the scenario/decision-support twin (Increment 1). Times are sim-time seconds; on the default calibrated run, 06:30 = 23400. Replace the edge ids with real ones from the net (netconvert/sumolib, or click an edge in sumo-gui). Run: python scripts/run_traci.py --no-gui --emit --emit-host 0.0.0.0 --jump-to 23400 --incident-file scripts/scenarios/incident_example.json
